hints.title: Cascade Reduction
hints.text: When two adjacent non-coprime numbers merge into their least common multiple, the new least common multiple can trigger further merges with previous numbers.

hints.title: LIFO Reduction Structure
hints.text: A stack allows you to compare the incoming number with the top element and repeatedly collapse while gcd > 1.

hints.title: LCM Formula
hints.text: The least common multiple of a and b is (a * b) // gcd(a, b).

hints.title: Stack-Based Merge Loop

complexity.notes: Each number is pushed and popped at most once, with GCD taking logarithmic steps.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Re-scanning the entire array after each merge results in O(n^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Stack stores remaining non-coprime merged values.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate identifies stack reduction pattern matching adjacent domino merges.
